messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] FOSS/GRASS 2004
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

With a little over a month left for the deadline for submission
of abstracts (30 April, 2004), I would like to remind the
subscribers of this list to kindly submit their abstracts
through the conference web-page 
(http://gisws.media.osaka-cu.ac.jp/grass04/).

The conference is scheduled to be held at Chulalongkorn University,
Bangkok, Thailand  from 12-14 September 2004. Details are
available on the conference web-site. Looking forward
to seeing many GRASS users and developers at the conference
and hoping that the conference would be a big success. Would also
like to request you all to pass on the info about the upcoming 
conference thru appropriate channels/forum that may be accessible
to you.

Kind regards

Raghavan

-------------
Dr. Venkatesh Raghavan
Grass Users Conference 2004
Co-cordinator
